fixed_in_this_iteration: BUG: Records-Player 'All-Time Best By Team' (and the two adjacent all-time tables) was rendering ui-avatars.com initial-letter placeholders for every team because seasonsResults' meta did not always carry team_avatar/owner_avatar from the latest league. Fix: added a single getRosterMapWithOwners(latest.league_id) fetch at load time, built a latestByOwnerKey lookup keyed by owner_username, and added latestMetaFor(meta) helper that all three all-time tables (allTimePlayoff, allTimeFull, allTimeBestByTeam) plus the playoffsMVP leaderboard now use to resolve historic rows back to the franchise's CURRENT branding. Verified visually: 44 of 69 team-avatar imgs on the page now resolve to sleepercdn.com real logos; remaining 25 are owners who genuinely never uploaded a Sleeper avatar (expected fallback).
